The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid.
